name: dwdz-sidebar-plugin
description: Feishu Bitable 边栏对账插件。源码在 plugin-center/sidebar-plugin/；根目录满足飞书审核：package.json 含 output=dist，构建后静态包在仓库根 dist/。

scripts.build: npm install --prefix plugin-center/sidebar-plugin && npm run build:block --prefix plugin-center/sidebar-plugin && npm run verify:block-dist --prefix plugin-center/sidebar-plugin && node scripts/verify-root-block-dist.mjs
scripts.build:block: npm run build:block --prefix plugin-center/sidebar-plugin && npm run verify:block-dist --prefix plugin-center/sidebar-plugin && node scripts/verify-root-block-dist.mjs
scripts.verify:block-dist: npm run verify:block-dist --prefix plugin-center/sidebar-plugin && node scripts/verify-root-block-dist.mjs
